concept.title: Leveraging storage quota limits in proxy organizations
concept.shortdesc: When a proxied namespace has quota limits configured, Red Hat Quay can auto-prune the least recently used image tags so that a new push that exceeds available storage is stored instead of being skipped.

ul.li: As part of the auto-pruning feature, the tags that are marked for deletion are eventually garbage collected by the garbage collector (gc) worker process. As a result, the quota size restriction is not fully enforced during this period.
Currently, the namespace quota size computation does not take into account the size for manifest child. This is a known issue and will be fixed in a future version of Red Hat Quay.
